correctness.rationale: The original package contains an incorrect endpoint-difference equality: it uses 8(1+d²) where algebra requires 8(1+d²)². Using full revised RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md the exact identity is 8(1+d²)²[K_d(1)²−K_d(c)²]=d(d³+4d²+d−4). Independent SymPy factorization confirmed both the corrected equality and the original residual division by (1+d²). The max-of-two-signs reduction has two branches; the first decreases and the second has a unique interior maximum, so global minima occur at t=c or t=1; cubic is strictly increasing on [0,1]. This proves the FINAL REPAIRED claim for d∈[0,1), including the endpoint d=0 and tie.
